completeReadScope.segments: All fifteen complete segments in comparisons-active/index.json; all 85 source files, including every frontmatter field and body.
completeReadScope.unchangedInitialCapture: comparisons/index.json is the abandoned fifteen-member, 183-candidate capture. It is not claimed completely read.
completeReadScope.absentCandidates: The active capture records eleven absent probes. None is a link, curated choice or authored exclusion.
completeReadScope.limit: This is bounded editorial inspection of actual labels, source meanings and complete relevant cards, not exhaustive all-deck semantic certification.

pairs.机: Exact desk/table overlap; a writing table is not a clearly wrong answer.
pairs.台: A stand or raised table is directly attested for 卓; do not confuse 台's machine counter with that overlap.
pairs.高: KANJIDIC2 high and Daijisen elevated/excellent senses; not an assertion that 卓 means expensive.
pairs.優: Superior/excellent overlaps eminence; gentleness is not the shared branch.
pairs.超: Surpassing the ordinary standard overlaps 卓's excellence as in 卓越; not all quantitative excess.
pairs.表: Reverse English-choice ambiguity: 卓's displayed table also names the data table in 表's ordinary secondary sense, even though the Japanese furniture and chart words differ.

declined.上: Directional up/above is not a direct replacement for furniture or eminence merely because rank can be described spatially.
declined.抜: The displayed extract is not a meaning of 卓. Compound 卓抜 alone does not make extraction and eminence interchangeable.
declined.勝: The displayed victory names a result, not a table or the property of eminence; no pair is inferred solely from praise or success.

卓.choices: 日 sun/day, 車 car/vehicle and 十 ten distinguish the central box, through-going axle and lower cross. They have distinct meanings and all belong to the actual Starter pool. They replace the semantically sound 早/朝/単 set because that set was absent from Starter padding, allowing a wrong ショク despite its attestation for 卓. Initial exposure is retained; the final model confirms every revised outcome fills all three slots in N1, All and Starter padding.

pairs.難: Adversity/trouble and calamity overlap the trouble branch of 難; not material hardness.
pairs.困: The trouble/difficulty branch of 厄介 connects with being in difficulty; the linked article distinguishes receiving care from being troublesome.
pairs.苦: Hardship and distress overlap the troublesome/adverse branch; bitter taste is not the shared meaning.
pairs.悪: Revised after rechecking the complete bare 厄 family 1537810: its explicit English evil gloss can collide with 悪's bad/evil label. This is English quiz-answer ambiguity, not an equation of misfortune with moral wickedness.

declined.害障: Harm or obstruction may cause trouble, but cause/result and generic adversity are insufficient for these displayed labels.
declined.患病: Ordinary illness is not an unrestricted meaning of 厄. The qualified historical smallpox use does not justify a modern generic illness pair.

厄.choices: 厚 thick/cordial, 原 original/plain and 印 stamp/mark are semantically distinct. The first two share 厂; 印 provides a bent-shape contrast.

pairs.天: Sky/heavens overlap the open space above ground.
pairs.気: The displayed air can mean the open air as well as 気's breath/atmosphere; the spatial/material distinction should not decide an unqualified English answer.
pairs.間: Reverse overlap with the new broad displayed space label and 間's ordinary gap/space sense; the words still have different applications.
pairs.覚: KANJIDIC2 explicitly includes memorization for 宙, and Daijisen/JMdict attest the memory branch. The by-heart use differs grammatically from memorizing, but memorize is not a safely wrong unqualified meaning.

declined.時久: The classical temporal 宙 account is qualified, not offered as the ordinary hour or elapsed-long-time word.
declined.暗: Neither displayed dark nor the new space/midair title creates a direct overlap; no pair from 暗記 co-occurrence alone.

宙.choices: 宅 residence, 守 guard/obey and 定 determine/settle share 宀 but not the air/space meaning. Being unsettled in 宙に浮く does not mean settle.

寸.titleDecision: Use sun (length unit); small rather than the ambiguous provisional small measure; sun. The body explains the length unit, not the English celestial object.

pairs.少: A small amount or very little is shared.
pairs.短: Shortness of extent or time is shared, including 寸暇.
pairs.細: Reverse small/fine-scale overlap: 細かい is explicitly small/fine in the actual comparison card; slenderness and detail are not unrestricted synonyms for 寸.
pairs.計測: The full source explicitly includes measurement, and the displayed measure is not restricted to a verb. A narrower unit title does not erase that attested meaning; exclude the measuring labels.

declined.量: Unspecified quantity/amount does not itself specify smallness or the named length unit; no pair based solely on a dimension being measurable.
declined.度分長: Different units, part/count concepts or the opposite long dimension do not justify exclusions merely through measurement.

寸.choices: 村 village, 付 attach and 寺 Buddhist temple contain 寸 but do not denote its unit or smallness.

pairs.安平寧和: Daijisen's peaceful/untroubled branch and KANJIDIC2 peace overlap these cards' peacefulness or harmony; not cheapness, flatness, politeness or Japanese style.
pairs.楽: KANJIDIC2 ease overlaps 楽's displayed ease; not music or necessarily enjoyment.
pairs.静: The peaceful, undisturbed branch overlaps quiet/stillness; this does not equate health with silence.
pairs.凪: The displayed lull overlaps the lull/respite in the inspected 小康 family; sea calm and medical remission remain contextually different.

康.choices: 庫 storehouse, 床 floor/bed and 庭 garden/yard have the same outer 广 but distinct meanings. A bed's use in recovery is not health itself.

pairs.広: Direct vast/wide/spacious overlap, not only shared landscape topic.
pairs.荒: Desert/wilderness and waste-land senses can yield overlapping English answers; rough surfaces or deliberate devastation are not definitions of every desert.

declined.遠: Distance from a point is not the same as breadth.
declined.疑迷: Doubting or hesitating is not identical to an indistinct description.
declined.空: The empty/sky label is not inferred from a sparsely occupied desert.
declined.砂: Sand is material; a desert is a region. Do not repeat a material/whole exclusion.

漠.choices: 漢 Chinese/Sino-, 暮 dusk/livelihood and 湖 lake are distinct despite shape or landscape associations.

pairs.札: Tag/ticket/label overlap explicitly attested in both families.
pairs.券: Ticket is an ordinary secondary sense of 票, not only a voting context.
pairs.符: Ticket/token overlaps the written ticket/slip branch; not every sign or charm.
pairs.標印: KANJIDIC2 explicitly includes sign for 票, in addition to label/ticket. Mark/sign labels therefore overlap independently of a shared component or pronunciation.

declined.表: A chart may display voting totals, but is not the vote/slip itself.
declined.紙: Paper is a possible material, not the functional meaning ballot/vote.
declined.記: Recording is an action; the relation to a written slip alone is insufficient.
declined.示: A visible component and indicating information do not make indicate a direct definition of 票.

票.choices: 栗 chestnut, 要 necessity/essentials and 祭 festival/ritual/worship are distinct; compare their lower 木, 女 and 示 forms.
票.dependentEdit: 標's explicit no-card statement becomes false upon adding 票. Link its substantive introduction and remove only that obsolete statement; retain its metadata, senses and exclusions.

pairs.妖: Bewitching/supernatural overlap, not every alluring appearance.
pairs.魅: Enchantment and independently attested spirit/monster overlap.
pairs.怪: Uncanny beings overlap; ordinary suspicion alone is not sorcery.
pairs.悪凶: The displayed evil overlaps malign supernatural influence. Neither pair asserts that all magic is morally evil or all bad luck is demonic.
pairs.符: Unqualified English charm can mean a magical spell; distinguish that reading from 符's talisman/token sense instead of relying on it as a plainly wrong magic choice.

declined.厄: Misfortune is an event/state, not the supernatural being or magic that might be imagined to cause it.
declined.神: A general deity is not automatically a demon; shared supernatural classification is not enough.

魔.choices: 摩 rub/chafe, 鹿 deer and 康 health/well-being offer the broad enclosing shape but distinct meanings. 摩's Sanskrit transcription use does not make rubbing mean magic.

nextGate: Bind the passed static/host checks, exact source membership and unchanged baseline to a recoverable freeze, then obtain blind independent review.
limitations: Author judgments may be revised after evidence-based independent review; none is a CLEAN verdict.

Both initial and revised choice graphs passed. Initial reading exposure found one 卓 Starter-padding hit; the revised Python model reports zero N1/All hits, zero Starter-padding hits and four latent readings outside those pools. No native or arbitrary-pool guarantee is made.
